body:
hello, so the appeal got denied and I'd like to state the few things Posighdun said before denying. I recommend you go read he final statement from Posighdun. Thanks.

alright, so this was all my neighbor and I know it. first point is the fact that Posighdun said  he thinks it was me because of me asking eteh not to name the alfs. I don't even have a single piece of memory of it being me . 

Now, that whole ddos thing. No I never dosed and I don't know how to ddos. My friend knows Peter in a bad way, and that's what I was referring to. 

Lastly, as much as I update hate to say this, but I'd like my 20 dollars back and I think I'm remaining banned due to you having a favourite Posighdun, like straight after eteh got kicked from cacal you got him straight into Cronus. 

Oh oh well tho, I personally believe I should have one more chance.

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello _Eth,

Your previous statements have been very unclear and suspicious. In previous appeals, you've made claims such as 
"I think it was my neighbor" or "I'm pretty sure my neighbor did it," in addition to "I don't remember anything." It's not very likely that you wouldn't remember evading a ban intentionally. Your alibi has been very confusing and contradicting, with you swaying back and forth between arguments. Chat logs have provided evidence of you admitting to ban evasion, in addition to the fact that JackHulk1's IP matches 100% with yours. Your ban will remain in place unless you can provide a full scenario and information to disprove the provided evidence.

Regards,
Rinn | Senior Moderator
